SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-04: FHIRPath — §5.2 Filtering and Projection. Test these items: where(criteria), select(projection), repeat(projection), ofType(type). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §5.2.1-§5.2.4: where(criteria), select(projection), repeat(projection), and ofType(type : type specifier) signatures require exactly the specified expression/type argument; ofType's type argument is a model type specifier, not a string expression.
issues.evidence: .temp/qa/fp04_explorer_probe.py found native/fallback divergence for malformed filtering/projection calls. Native fhirpath_is_valid returned true and evaluated data for Patient.where(), item.where(), item.where(true, false).linkId, item.select(), item.select(linkId, item).count(), item.repeat(), and Patient.ofType('Patient').id; forced fallback returned invalid/empty. Example: Patient.where() native returned the full Patient resource while fallback returned fhirpath_is_valid=false and empty/NULL.
issues.root_cause: Native C++ Section 5.2 evaluators did not enforce exact argument counts for where/select/repeat, and evalOfType accepted a StringLiteral child as though it were a model type specifier. Missing or extra arguments therefore reached evaluation and either returned input data or used only the first argument.
issues.resolution: Added exact arity checks in evalWhere and evalFunction for select/repeat, rejected StringLiteral arguments in evalOfType, added Python parity tests and native sqllogictest guards, rebuilt and copied the bundled fhirpath.duckdb_extension.
issues.verified_in: .temp/qa/fp04_explorer_probe_after_fix.log: mismatch_count=0; pytest test_filter_projection_parity.py: 8 passed; pytest test_type_parity.py + test_environment_type_parity.py: 15 passed; native unittest: 356 assertions; full conformance: 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §3.2 and §5.2.4: polymorphic paths may be filtered with ofType(type), and ofType returns input items whose resolved model type matches the requested type or subclass.
issues.evidence: .temp/qa/fp04_explorer_probe.py found entry.resource.ofType(Observation).value.ofType(Integer) over a Bundle containing Observation.valueInteger=7. Native C++ returned fhirpath=["7"] / fhirpath_json=[7], but forced Python fallback returned empty/NULL despite the valueInteger choice satisfying Integer.
issues.root_cause: The forced Python fallback only patched fhirpathpy choice-type ofType misses for simple root-level expressions like value.ofType(Integer). When the choice path appeared after a projection/filter chain, the evaluator could resolve the source value but the trailing ofType filter saw an empty result and no generic fallback reapplied type filtering to the source expression.
issues.resolution: Extended the fallback choice-ofType helper to recognize trailing .ofType(Type) expressions, evaluate the source expression, validate the requested type through the existing TypeSpecifier path, and filter with the existing of_type_fn semantics. Explicit System.* trailing choice filters remain empty to preserve native behavior.
issues.verified_in: .temp/qa/fp04_explorer_probe_after_fix.log: entry.resource.ofType(Observation).value.ofType(Integer) native and fallback both returned ["7"]/[7]; pytest test_filter_projection_parity.py: 8 passed; full conformance: 2822/2822
